title: Transfer of work of Iron and Steel products falling under Chapter 72 (4 HSN Codes) and Chapter 73 (250 HSN Codes) of the HSN Classification hitherto handled by DPIIT to M/o Steel

text: F. No. P-29014/30/2021-LEI (E-file no. 54989) Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (LEI Section) OFFICE MEMORANDUM Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi Dated: 4th November, 2025 Subject: Transfer of work of Iron and steel products falling under Chapter 72 (4 HSN Codes) and Chapter 73 (250 HSN Codes) of the HSN Classification hitherto handled by DPIIT to M/o Steel -reg. The undersigned is hereby directed to refer to subject cited above and to inform that Hon'ble Commerce & Industry Minister has approved transfer of all work of Iron and Steel products falling under Chapter 72 (4 HSN Codes) and Chapter 73 (250 HSN Codes) of the HSN Classification hitherto handled by DPIIT from Department of Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) to Ministry of Steel with immediate effect. 2. As per the advice of Department of Legal Affairs (DoLA), 13 QCOs on Steel products (details is as per Annexure-I) issued by DPIIT, will stand withdrawn with effect from the date on which the Ministry of Steel notifies corresponding QCOs. A separate Order in this regard is to be notified in thee-gazette by DPIIT. 3. Similarly, Minimum Import Price (MIP) has been imposed by DGFT (copy enclosed) on the recommendation of DPI IT on the following products which need to be administrated by Ministry of Steel with immediate effect :- [Screws- HSN codes 731811 , 731812, 731813, 731814, 731815, and 731819]. [Roller Chains and parts thereof: HSN codes 73151100, 73151900, and 73159000]. 4. All the other work which is being done by DPIIT for development of Industries falling under Chapter-72 and Chanpter-73 of HSN Classification hitherto handled by DPIIT (for example Foundry Development Council etc) which was constituted by DPIIT is also beinng transferred from DPIIT to Ministry of Steel.
